prompt_instructions: Attach consented subject images or use a fictional model.
Use no stickers, extra subjects, wardrobe changes, neon shifts or sci-fi elements.
Use approved music artwork and UI only when rights are available.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Urban Streetwear Editorial Collage. Aspect ratio 9:16. Editorial poster-style multi-panel collage with retro analog–digital fusion mood; warm ambers, washed neutrals, soft greys, muted browns; reflective glass, wool plaid, polished leather, stone pavement. Core outfit: brown plaid blazer, white button-up shirt, yellow tie, loose dark trousers; brown cap, oversized amber-tinted rectangular sunglasses and wired earphones. Top-left is a reflective window shot holding phone in front of face with layered ghosting, architectural overlays and curvature distortion. Top-right is a close-range downward-angled ultra-wide portrait on a cobblestone street, leaning forward with hands in pockets and exaggerated pout, with lens perspective distortion and radiating cobblestones. Bottom-right is an intimate overhead selfie under soft overcast light, holding a drink, with faint digital grid and minimal square facial-bounding graphic. Center UI is a translucent iOS-style Apple Music mini-player with See You Again by Tyler, The Creator, artwork, timeline and playback controls with no shadows. Subtle cursor-like frame lines and rectangular highlights. Negative constraints: Stickers, extra subjects, wardrobe changes, incorrect UI icons, neon color shifts, futuristic sci-fi elements.
prompt.negative_prompt: stickers, extra subjects, wardrobe changes, incorrect UI icons, neon color shifts, futuristic sci-fi elements, distorted face, low resolution, watermark
